name: Silence
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

Choose a point within long range. An invisible sphere with a radius of short range appears, centered on that point. No sound can be created within or pass through the sphere, and spells with effects that rely on vibration have no effect within the sphere.

Describe how silence falls.
successes:
✨: You may extend the radius by 5 ft.

🌞: You may sustain the spell for up to 1 hour.

💀: The effect of the spell inverts. All sound emitted within the sphere is doubled in volume and any spell effects that rely on vibration are doubled as they pass within the sphere. Check a Condition.
